title: Sales workflows with ChatGPT Work
summary: Learn practical ChatGPT Work workflows for pipeline briefs, meeting prep, account plans, forecast reviews, and deal diagnosis.
body: Learn practical ChatGPT Work workflows for pipeline briefs, meeting prep, account plans, forecast reviews, and deal diagnosis.
summaryZh: 本文阐述了如何使用ChatGPT Work提升销售团队的执行效率，提供了涵盖销售漏斗简报、会议准备、客户账户计划、预测审查以及交易诊断等场景的实用工作流示例。原始信息显示：Learn practical ChatGPT Work workflows for pipeline briefs, meeting prep, account plans, forecast reviews, and deal diagnosis.。该消息由OpenAI发布，主题为“Sales workflows with ChatGPT Work”。其重要性主要体现在：OpenAI介绍了ChatGPT Work在销售工作流中的具体应用，涵盖销售漏斗简报、客户账户规划与交易诊断等。建议结合原文核对关键数据、适用条件、技术限制与后续更新，以判断其对实际产品和研发决策的影响。
